transcript.text: Hi everyone. As we approach the production policy review on August 25, I want to make sure we're all aligned on the process. I'll be making the final decision on the rate-limit policy that gets communicated to customers, but before I do, I need each of your teams to report your release-impacting findings. To recap where the draft stands: we're looking at 100 requests per minute for ordinary API keys, the same limit applied to authentication endpoints, and no staffed launch window specified. transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.speaker: A3

The finding isn't in the security tracker yet because the investigation is still being closed, but this needs to be reflected in the final policy before it goes to customers.

transcript.speaker: A5
